name: Forms for the End of the World
summary: Mayor Somerton insists the village's last forms be stamped in triplicate before the world may end.

stages.journal: Mayor Somerton has set up a desk in the Founder's Round and wants three forms stamped before the hysteria may officially proceed: 14-B, 22, and a Writ of Passage.
stages.hint: Get the three stamps: the clock-chamber stamp, the schoolhouse seal, and the constable's. Forge one if you must.

stages.journal: The forms are in order, or look it. Wendel will issue the Writ of Passage.
stages.hint: Take the forms back to the mayor.

stages.journal: Wendel issued a Writ of Passage that no mob can ignore without filling in a form first.
The charm broke before the last stamp was found. Wendel filed the three forms anyway, and the world, strictly, did not end.
A forged stamp, a sharp-eyed deputy, and a short stay in the cells for the party.
